command:
set -eu
printf "== identity ==\n"
uname -a
sysctl -n hw.machine kern.osversion 2>/dev/null || true
printf "== rootfs mount ==\n"
mount | grep -E "(/var/mnt/rootfs|/private/var/mnt/rootfs)" || true
printf "== rootfs files ==\n"
ls -ld /var/mnt/rootfs /var/mnt/rootfs/System /var/mnt/rootfs/System/Library/CoreServices/SystemVersion.plist 2>&1 || true
if test -f /var/mnt/rootfs/System/Library/CoreServices/SystemVersion.plist; then /usr/bin/plutil -p /var/mnt/rootfs/System/Library/CoreServices/SystemVersion.plist | head -20; fi
printf "== relevant processes ==\n"
ps -Ao pid,ppid,state,etime,command | grep -E "macwshostd|launchdchrootexec|WindowServer|OSXvnc|macws(display|input|interop)d|macos_gui" | grep -v grep || true
printf "== launch jobs ==\n"
launchctl list | grep -Ei "macwsguide|macws|windowserver" || true
printf "== recent host log ==\n"
tail -60 /var/mobile/Library/Logs/MacWSHostd.log 2>&1 || true
printf "== recent GUI watchdog log ==\n"
tail -80 /var/jb/var/mobile/macos_gui_watchdog.log 2>&1 || true
printf "== recent WindowServer stderr ==\n"
tail -80 /var/jb/var/mobile/WindowServer.err 2>&1 || true
